hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); [[ "$f" == *"_posts/"*.md ]] && slug=$(basename "$f" .md) && printf '{"systemMessage":"Word cloud reminder:\n  uv run _scripts/generate_wordcloud.py -f %s -s img/new_post_word_cloud.png -c assets/%s.png"}\n' "$f" "$slug" 2>/dev/null || true
